title: General Awareness & Science Mock Championship 2026
description: Comprehensive practice test covering General Science, World Geography, Indian Polity, and History.

questions.text: Which of the following metals remains in liquid state at normal room temperature?
questions.explanation: Mercury (Hg) is the only metal that is liquid at standard room temperature. Bromine is a liquid at room temperature, but it is a non-metal.

questions.text: Which layer of the Earth's atmosphere is home to almost all weather phenomena like clouds and rain?
questions.explanation: The troposphere is the lowest atmospheric layer containing roughly 75% of the atmosphere's mass and almost all water vapor, causing all weather events.

questions.text: Which cell organelle is widely known as the 'Powerhouse of the Cell'?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria produce cellular energy in the form of ATP (adenosine triphosphate) through aerobic respiration, earning the title 'Powerhouse of the Cell'.

questions.text: What is the primary function of the Central Processing Unit (CPU) in a computer?
options: To execute instructions and perform calculations
To supply electrical power to components
questions.explanation: The CPU is the central brain of a computer system that fetches, decodes, and executes program instructions and mathematical operations.

questions.text: On which date is International Yoga Day celebrated globally every year?
questions.explanation: International Yoga Day is observed worldwide annually on June 21, established by the United Nations General Assembly in 2014.

title: Logical Reasoning & Mental Ability Speed Test
description: Speed test testing Coding-Decoding, Number Series, Analogies, and Deductive Reasoning.

questions.text: Find the missing number in the given sequence: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.explanation: Pattern: The differences between consecutive numbers increase by 2: +4, +6, +8, +10, so the next difference is +12. Thus, 30 + 12 = 42 (or n * (n+1): 1x2=2, 2x3=6, 3x4=12, 4x5=20, 5x6=30, 6x7=42).

questions.text: In a certain code language, if 'CAT' is coded as '3120', how will 'DOG' be coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is represented by its alphabetical positional rank: C=3, A=1, T=20 -> 3120. Similarly, D=4, O=15, G=7 -> 4157.

questions.text: Select the odd one out from the given four options:
questions.explanation: Carrot, Potato, and Ginger all grow underground as roots/tubers/rhizomes, whereas Tomato grows above ground and is botanically a fruit.

questions.text: Pointing to a photograph, Rohit said, 'She is the only daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is Rohit related to the girl?
questions.explanation: Rohit's grandfather's only son is Rohit's father. The only daughter of Rohit's father is Rohit's sister. Therefore, Rohit is her brother.

title: Computer Science & IT Fundamentals Test
description: Core test covering Computer Memory, Operating Systems, Networking, and Web Technologies.

questions.text: Which of the following computer memories is volatile in nature?
questions.explanation: RAM is volatile memory; it requires electrical power to retain its state and loses all stored data when the system is powered off.

questions.text: What does HTML stand for in web development?
questions.explanation: HTML stands for 'Hyper Text Markup Language'. It is the standard markup language used to structure web pages on the World Wide Web.

questions.text: How many Megabytes (MB) make up exactly 1 Gigabyte (GB) in standard binary computing?
questions.explanation: In binary computing architecture, 1 Gigabyte (GB) = 1024 Megabytes (MB), and 1 MB = 1024 Kilobytes (KB).
